verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local MoE inference engine. It is operated through CLI flags, scripts and Python APIs such as `edge0 serve`, `--no-lora` and `AutoEngine`. Its chat and OpenAI-compatible endpoint let users send natural-language prompts to the hosted model, but that is the model's workload, not natural-language control of the product itself. Nothing in the pack shows users configuring, launching or managing Edge0 through natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
